mapper.select: SELECT config_unit_name, unified_social_credit_code, legal_person, a.license_device_name, ownership_nature, a.ladder_config_model, equipment_config_address, detailed_address, issuing_authority, issue_date, a.license_no, b.institution_id from biz_license_original a left join biz_application b on a.application_id = b.id where a.id = #{id}

SELECT a.production_enterprise, a.specific_model, product_serial_no, a.installation_date, info_submit_date, duplicate_issuing_authority, duplicate_issue_date, remark, b.purchase_price, b.equipment_users, b.special_description, a.original_position, equipment_id, a.extra FROM biz_license_duplicate a left join biz_class_a_equipment b on a.equipment_id = b.id where a.id = #{id}

select d.id as application_id, a.id as original_id, b.id as duplicate_id, a.license_no, a.issue_date, a.license_device_name, a.ladder_config_model, a.equipment_config_address, c.production_enterprise, c.specific_model, c.installation_date, d.app_type, b.equipment_id, IF(b.id IS NOT NULL, 'Y', 'N') AS has_duplicate, IF(b.acceptance_status = 1, 'Y', 'N') AS has_acceptance_material from biz_license_original a left join biz_license_duplicate b on a.id = b.original_id left join biz_application d on d.id = a.application_id left join biz_class_a_equipment c on d.equipment_id = c.id
and (d.creator = #{userId} or d.institution_id =#{deptId}) and d.app_status = 5 and a.deleted = 0 and b.deleted = 0 and c.deleted = 0
and a.license_device_name = #{type}
order by a.create_time desc

INSERT INTO biz_license_duplicate ( original_id, production_enterprise, info_submit_date, specific_model, duplicate_issuing_authority, product_serial_no, duplicate_issue_date, installation_date, acceptance_status, remark, status, creator, original_position ) VALUES ( #{vo.originalId}, #{vo.productionEnterprise}, #{vo.infoSubmitDate}, #{vo.specificModel}, #{vo.duplicateIssuingAuthority}, #{vo.productSerialNo}, #{vo.duplicateIssueDate}, #{vo.installationDate}, 0, #{vo.remark}, 1, #{creator}, #{vo.originalPosition}
)

INSERT INTO biz_license_original ( application_id, license_no, config_unit_name, ownership_nature, issuing_authority, unified_social_credit_code, ladder_config_model, issue_date, legal_person, equipment_config_address, license_device_name, detailed_address, valid_date, status, creator ) VALUES ( #{appId}, #{vo.licenseNo}, #{vo.configUnitName}, #{vo.ownershipNature}, #{vo.issuingAuthority}, #{vo.unifiedSocialCreditCode}, #{vo.ladderConfigModel}, #{vo.issueDate}, #{vo.legalPerson}, #{vo.equipmentConfigAddress}, #{vo.licenseDeviceName}, #{vo.detailedAddress}, #{validDate}, #{vo.status}, #{creator} )
